rationale: The discourse has become more quantitative, but the core conflict remains unresolved: investors/management still insist on closure-capable structural change, while IG Metall, the Works Council, and Lower Saxony hold firm no-closure/site-protection red lines. The expert narrowed the savings gap but did not bridge it, so further direct bargaining is likely to circle unless an external mediator reframes trade-offs or tests a concrete package.
